name: vivo and iQOO (Funtouch OS and OriginOS)

packages.label: Lockscreen Poster
packages.reason: Puts stories and promo posters on the lock screen.

packages.label: V-Appstore
packages.reason: vivo's app store. Pushes app promos, but also updates some vivo apps.

packages.label: Smart Launcher feed
packages.reason: The swipe-left cards page with suggested content. Its shortcuts go with it.

packages.label: Global Search
packages.reason: Home-screen search with promoted results. The search swipe stops working.

packages.label: vivo Browser
packages.reason: Browser with ads and news pushes. Set another browser as default first.

packages.label: i Theme
packages.reason: Theme and wallpaper store with promos. You can't change themes while it is off.

packages.label: vivo push
packages.reason: vivo's own push channel. Some vivo app notifications may stop.
